items.question: "What about spare parts from China? Will I have to wait a month?"
items.answer: No. We keep a warehouse in Poland with key parts - seals, filters, buckets and hydraulic components, among others. For our mini excavators, we use components compatible with KOOP, Briggs & Stratton and Kubota, available from Polish distributors. Typical service response time: 48h.

items.question: "Who will repair it? No service center knows these machines."
items.answer: We will. We have our own mobile technical service. The engines in our machines are standard units - any experienced mechanic can handle them. Every machine comes with a Polish-language user manual and parts catalogue.

items.question: "At this price, something must be wrong"
items.answer: Ask our customers what they think about our mini excavators. We will gladly put you in touch with someone who uses our mini excavators, for example on a construction site. A first-hand opinion means more than ours.

promise.title: Ready to work from day one
promise.text: Every Bergson excavator goes through a full pre-delivery inspection with us - before it reaches you, we change the engine and hydraulic oil, check the electrical installation and inspect all mechanical systems. You buy a machine fully prepared for work, with no hidden surprises. You do not need to do anything - once delivered, you can start working right away.

items.q: How do I transport the excavator to the construction site?
items.a: Our mini excavators fit on a standard car trailer up to 3.5 t GVW. Transporting them on a trailer with a passenger car is not a problem.
Machines available from stock are delivered within 5-14 business days. Made-to-order models are delivered within 3-4 weeks. We confirm current availability during the quotation process.

items.q: Can I buy as a company and use leasing?
items.a: Yes. We issue VAT invoices for companies and private individuals. We work with leasing companies - the installment for a BM12 machine is around PLN 650-800 per month with a 60-month lease.

items.q: What happens if something breaks after a year?
items.a: The warranty covers 12 months. After it ends, we offer paid mobile service and spare parts sales from our warehouse in Poland.

items.q: Can I test the machine before buying?
items.a: Yes - we invite you to a presentation at our showroom in Poznań. You can try the machine in real working conditions. Contact us to arrange a date.

items.q: Are the mini excavators new? Do they have CE certificates?
items.a: All machines are brand new and come with a CE declaration of conformity. We provide full technical documentation and a user manual in Polish.

gwarancja.title: Warranty Terms
gwarancja.intro: This document sets out the rules for granting and performing the warranty for Bergson Machines branded Goods. This document is an integral part of the Bergson Machines Sales Terms and Conditions.

blocks.text: The warranty for Bergson Machines branded Goods is granted by Better Solutions Spółka z ograniczoną odpowiedzialnością, with its registered office in Czapury (61-160), ul. Poznańska 7, KRS: 0000837608, NIP: 7252298652, hereinafter referred to as the Warrantor.
The warranty is granted voluntarily and does not exclude, limit or suspend the Buyer’s rights arising from the laws on non-conformity of goods with the contract.

The warranty covers physical defects of the Goods arising from causes inherent in the Goods themselves, provided that the Goods are used under normal operating conditions and in accordance with the user manual supplied by the Warrantor.

items: BM10, BM12, BM12C mini excavators - 12 months from the date the Goods are handed over to the Buyer;
working attachments (buckets, breakers, augers) - 12 months from the date of handover;
spare parts supplied under a warranty repair - 3 months or until the end of the original warranty period, whichever expires later.
mechanical, electrical or hydraulic damage caused by the Buyer or third parties;
faults resulting from improper operation, maintenance or installation of attachments contrary to the instructions;
natural wear and tear of consumable parts, in particular filters, oils, seals, rubber hoses, rubber and steel tracks, bulbs and fuses;
damage caused by use of the Goods contrary to their intended purpose, overload or lack of regular service inspections;
faults caused by the use of non-original spare parts or operating fluids not approved by the manufacturer;
damage resulting from force majeure, including flood, fire, lightning discharge or frost below the permissible operating temperature;
Goods with tampered or illegible serial numbers.

blocks.text: Step 1 - Defect notification. The Buyer is obliged to report the defect immediately after discovering it, no later than within 14 days, by e-mail to: kontakt@bergsonmachines.pl.

items: a detailed description of the defect found, together with photo or video documentation;
the machine serial number from the nameplate;
the purchase date and a copy of the proof of purchase, in particular a VAT invoice or receipt;
the Buyer’s contact details and the location of the Goods.

blocks.text: Step 2 - Claim assessment. The Warrantor confirms receipt of the claim within 2 business days and indicates whether the repair will be performed at the place of use of the Goods or whether the Goods must be delivered to a service point.

Step 3 - Fulfilment. The Warrantor reviews the warranty claim and begins fulfilment within 14 business days from proper delivery of the claim. If the claim is accepted, the Warrantor, at its own discretion, will repair the Goods, supply and install a spare part, or replace the Goods with defect-free Goods.
Step 4 - Collection of the Goods. After the repair is completed, the Warrantor notifies the Buyer that the Goods are ready for collection or arranges delivery at the Warrantor’s expense.

The cost of delivering the Goods to the service point and collecting them after the warranty repair is borne by the Warrantor, provided that the defect has been recognized as covered by the warranty. If the claim proves unfounded, the transport and diagnostic costs are borne by the Buyer.

The Warrantor may issue the Buyer with a warranty card in paper or electronic form. The absence of a warranty card does not deprive the Buyer of warranty rights - proof of purchase is sufficient to exercise them.

sections.heading: Complaint due to non-conformity of the Goods with the Contract

blocks.text: The Seller is liable for any non-conformity of the Goods with the Contract under the rules set out in the Act of 30 May 2014 on consumer rights - in relations with Consumers - and under the Civil Code - in relations with B2B Buyers.
The Seller is liable for any non-conformity of the Goods with the Contract existing at the time of delivery and revealed within two years from that moment.

items: request repair of the Goods;
request replacement of the Goods with defect-free Goods;
request a price reduction - if repair or replacement is impossible, excessively costly, or the Seller has refused to perform it;
withdraw from the Contract and receive a full refund - if the non-conformity is material and the repair or replacement has proven ineffective or the Seller has refused to perform it.

blocks.text: It is presumed that a non-conformity revealed within one year from delivery of the Goods already existed at the time of delivery, unless the Seller proves otherwise.
In relations with B2B Buyers, liability under the statutory warranty for defects is excluded pursuant to Article 558 § 1 of the Civil Code.
A B2B Buyer may pursue rights only under the Warranty described in the Bergson Machines Warranty Terms document or under terms individually agreed with the Seller in writing.

sections.heading: Right of withdrawal from the Contract - Consumers

blocks.text: A Consumer who concluded a Contract at a distance or off-premises has the right to withdraw from it without giving any reason within 14 days from the day of taking possession of the Goods.

The right of withdrawal does not apply if the Goods were manufactured or modified according to the Consumer’s individual specification, are Goods imported directly from production on special order, or have clearly deteriorated for reasons attributable to the Consumer.

items: submit a clear statement of withdrawal by e-mail to kontakt@bergsonmachines.pl or in writing to the Seller’s registered office address - before the 14-day deadline expires;
return the Goods within 14 days from the date of submitting the statement, unchanged insofar as possible, preferably in the original packaging, to the address indicated by the Seller;

blocks.text: The Seller refunds all payments received, including standard delivery costs, without undue delay and no later than within 14 days from the date of receiving the withdrawal statement. The Seller may withhold the refund until receiving the Goods or confirmation of their dispatch.

A complaint regarding non-conformity of the Goods with the Contract or warranty rights should be submitted by e-mail, in writing, or through an authorized Bergson Machines dealer from whom the Goods were purchased.

items: the Buyer’s full name and contact details;
the order number or VAT invoice number;
the serial number of the Goods;
a detailed description of the defect or non-conformity together with photo or video documentation;
the Buyer’s request, in particular repair, replacement, price reduction or refund.

blocks.text: The Seller reviews the complaint and provides a response within 14 calendar days in the case of a Consumer and within 14 business days in the case of a B2B Buyer submitting a warranty complaint.
No response to a Consumer within 14 calendar days means that the complaint is deemed justified. The response is sent by e-mail or in writing - at the Buyer’s request.

items: mediation conducted by the competent Trade Inspection Inspectorate;
proceedings before the Permanent Consumer Arbitration Court at the Trade Inspection;

blocks.text: The Seller is not obliged to use out-of-court dispute resolution methods, but may agree to participate in a specific proceeding.

seoContent.label: Guide
seoContent.title: Mini excavators for sale - which mini excavator should you choose and how much does a mini excavator cost?
seoContent.lead: A mini excavator, meaning a small excavator for precise work, is useful both for construction and installation jobs as well as on private properties. For many people, it is not only the mini excavator price that matters, but also whether a given machine is suitable for garden work, home use and regular earthworks.

blocks.title: 1 ton, 1.5 t or 2 t - which mini excavator should you choose?
blocks.text: 1-ton models work better in tight spaces and for lighter tasks. People comparing phrases such as 1.5 t mini excavator, 2 t mini excavator or mini excavator for the garden are usually looking for a balance between size, stability and performance for earthworks.

blocks.title: How much does a mini excavator cost and what affects the price?
blocks.text: The price depends on the configuration, engine, presence of a cabin and additional attachments. If you are searching phrases such as mini excavator price, new mini excavator price, mini excavator prices or small excavator price, in practice you are mainly comparing the machine class, equipment and service availability.

blocks.title: Mini excavator for the garden, home and earthworks
blocks.text: When buying, not only the machine itself matters, but also parts availability and service response time. Whether you are interested in a mini excavator for the garden, a mini excavator for home use, a micro excavator or a Chinese mini excavator for earthworks, these factors have the biggest impact on reducing downtime and the real operating cost.

seoContent.footerText: Check the available models, compare attachments and choose a configuration suited to the type of work you do most often.
